title: Greetings and courtesy
label: ch:russian-greetings
canDo: I can greet someone in Russian, respond courteously, and close the exchange naturally.

payoff.summary: Complete RU-C01-practice, the canonical closing checkpoint, and demonstrate the chapter promise: greet someone in Russian, respond courteously, and close the exchange naturally.
payoff.note: Chapter 1 is schema-v2, so the payoff is atom-scored: RU-C01-practice assesses all eight atoms of the chapter's spoken layer — the six words, the formal/informal greeting register its recall asks for, and the courtesy dialogue it introduces. That is 8 of 18 (0.44), below the 0.5 floor, because the other ten are Cyrillic letter atoms that the writing runway (RU-W01 to RU-W05, sequences 40-64) introduces after this recap at sequence 35; the recap cannot score them without assessing atoms before they exist. Closing the gap needs a terminal checkpoint after the runway, not a wider list here.
